description.value: Legends Bistro is the clubhouse restaurant at Cultus Lake Golf Club, set in a beautiful solarium with views of the fairways and surrounding mountains. It serves the public year-round across breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with a menu spanning American classics, pizza, sandwiches, and salads alongside a full bar. Themed weekly dinner nights and proximity to Cultus Lake's recreational area make it a natural stop for cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley corridor.

address.value: 4000 Columbia Valley Road, Cultus Lake, BC V2R 5H6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Legends Bistro is the restaurant at Cultus Lake Golf Club, open to the public year-round serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The phone number (604) 858-9902 and address 4000 Columbia Valley Road, Cultus Lake, BC V2R 5H6 are corroborated by both OSM and multiple pages of the website. Takeout is explicitly offered via phone and Skip the Dishes; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenities is found anywhere in the website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible restaurant open year-round with confirmed contact details and an active 2026 events calendar. A useful food and drink stop for cyclists on the Columbia Valley Road corridor.
